# Project Portfolio Management

> A plan registry and project-management tool: one recursive plan collection with an optional kind label, a Rust matcher library for explainable duplicate detection, a loco.rs REST service (governance, scheduling, cost, approvals, controlled documents), and a SvelteKit UI.

## Facts

- Version: 0.4.0
- Projects: `project-portfolio-management-service-with-rust` (service), `project-portfolio-management-matcher-with-rust` (matcher), `project-portfolio-management-ui-with-svelte` (ui)
- Stack: Rust 1.99.1 (minimum 1.96), loco.rs 1.2, sea-orm 2.0, axum 0.8, PostgreSQL 18
- Stack: SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 (runes), Node 26, pnpm
- Stack: Lily Design System widgets (@lilydesignsystem/*)
- Stack: Podman with Compose to run it
- Run: `podman compose up -d --build --wait`
- Run: `cd project-portfolio-management-ui-with-svelte && pnpm install && pnpm dev`
- Check: `cd project-portfolio-management-service-with-rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --lib`
- Check: `cd project-portfolio-management-ui-with-svelte && pnpm run check && npx vitest run && pnpm exec playwright test`
- Rule: Spec first: a behavioural change is one commit with a spec edit, a code edit and a test edit.
- Rule: Say plainly what is not built or not tested.
- Rule: Stage named files; run scripts/generate-status.sh after adding tests.

## Specification

- [Entity living spec](spec/index.md): Entity-level contract: the Plan model, the trio, shared invariants; index of sections 1-18
- [Domain model](spec/05-domain-model.md): The Plan DTO, optional kind label, recursive containment, records and derived views
- [Functional requirements](spec/06-functional-requirements.md): What the system must do
- [Architecture](spec/08-architecture.md): Layers, components and dependency direction
- [API surface](spec/09-api-surface.md): Entity-level REST contract
- [Persistence](spec/10-persistence.md): The plans table, JSONB payload and supporting tables
- [Testing strategy](spec/11-testing-strategy.md): Normative test inventory
- [Compliance](spec/12-compliance.md): Privacy, audit and integrity obligations
- [Entity tasks](spec/13-tasks.md): Numbered build-out (T-n) with status
- [Implementation status](spec/14-implementation-status.md): What is built versus specified
- [Roadmap](spec/15-roadmap.md): Planned direction
- [Open questions](spec/16-open-questions.md): Unresolved decisions
- [Change control](spec/18-change-control.md): How spec changes are made
- [Time-based analysis](spec/time-based-analysis.md): Cycle and lead time, flow efficiency, forecasting rules
- [Bulk import/export](spec/bulk-import-export.md): Design of asynchronous import and export jobs
- [PRINCE2 mapping](spec/prince2/index.md): How the service maps to PRINCE2
- [Total Project Control](spec/total-project-control/index.md): DIPP, banding and portfolio triage
- [Flow framework metrics](spec/flow-framework-metrics/index.md): Flow distribution and related metrics
- [Keycloak test containers](spec/testcontainers-keycloak/index.md): Testing against a Keycloak container
- [API crate spec](project-portfolio-management-service-with-rust/spec/index.md): Living spec for the Rust service, including section 9 routes and section 13 tasks
- [Matcher crate spec](project-portfolio-management-matcher-with-rust/spec/index.md): Living spec for the matching library: weights, rules, normalization
- [UI spec](project-portfolio-management-ui-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Living spec for the SvelteKit operator UI
